issues: Between the 'Dauer min' input (right≈670) and the 'Preis CHF' input (x≈845) there is a ~175 px gap because Dauer's inner input is width w-16 (64 px) while the grid cell reserves a full 1fr slot. rca of the issue: Original problem: previous CSS used `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6` (6 side-by-side fields) and a fixed 8-column pixel grid `md:grid-cols-[120px_130px_100px_120px_140px_120px_1fr_auto]` totalling >730 px minimum + gaps, which overflowed the ~660 px inner container at iPad-portrait (768 px) and even truncated Anlegen/Status at 1024 px. Fix: split into two responsive rows — form uses `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` + `sm:grid-cols-[1fr_180px_auto]`; invoice rows use `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5` for data + `flex flex-wrap` for actions. Verified viewport widths 768/1024/1440 all have scrollWidth == clientWidth (no horizontal scroll) and all testids fully within the viewport.
